Camera: shows the road ahead or acts as a rear-view mirror. The picture is only displayed on your screen. It is never recorded, saved or uploaded.
Precise location (GPS): used on your device to calculate speed, distance, altitude and moving / standing time. It is only used while Extra Mirror is open, and it is never stored or shared.

Extra Mirror does not have accounts or servers and the developer does not receive any data about you. This is a summary; the full policy is available online.

The camera picture is shown live on your screen and processed only in your device\'s memory. No photos or videos are taken, saved or sent anywhere. The camera is used only while Extra Mirror is open on screen, and you can turn it off in Settings.

Precise GPS location is used on your device to calculate speed, trip distance, altitude and moving / standing time. Location coordinates are never stored or shared. Location is used only while the app is open on screen; the app does not ask for background location.

Your preferences (units, brightness, speedometer style, camera choice) and the current trip counters are kept only on your device. They are excluded from backups and device transfers, and are deleted when you uninstall the app or clear its storage.

The app shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may collect your advertising ID, IP address (approximate location), device information and ad interactions to serve, measure and, with your consent where required, personalize ads. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland, and where US state laws apply, you are asked for your choices through Google\'s consent form, and you can change them at any time from \"Privacy choices\". You can also reset or delete your advertising ID in Android Settings > Privacy > Ads.
The app contains no analytics or tracking SDK of its own.
You can revoke the camera or location permission at any time in Android Settings > Apps > Extra Mirror > Permissions. The app keeps working without them, with the corresponding feature turned off.
